# Fixture Project

Helix decomposes coding-agent harnesses into common lego atoms and product-specific personality atoms.

The common atoms provide session storage, hook dispatch, provider event normalization, default tools, runtime lifecycle, prompt assembly, and UI projection.

Product atoms preserve upstream behavior for OpenCode, Pi, and Nanobot.
